title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Crewe
Salary: Basic salary & OTE £34,500
Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:30pm, 1 in 3 Saturdays 8:30am-12:00pm
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

LOOKING FOR YOUR NEXT SERVICE ADVISOR ROLE?
Are you an experienced Service Advisor looking for your next opportunity within a busy automotive dealership?
We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused Service Advisor to join an established automotive business in Crewe. As a Service Advisor, you'll be the key link between customers and the workshop, ensuring every vehicle booking, service, repair and customer interaction is managed professionally from initial booking through to vehicle collection.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
£34,500 OTE
Performance-related bonus and productivity incentives
Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:30pm
1 in 3 Saturday mornings, 8:30am-12:00pm
Full-time, permanent position
28 days annual leave including bank holidays
Manufacturer training and career development
Employee vehicle purchase and servicing discounts
Friendly and supportive working environment
Genuine opportunity to develop your automotive career

THE ROLE
As a Service Advisor, you'll be responsible for delivering a professional and customer-focused aftersales experience while ensuring workshop operations run smoothly.
Working closely with customers, technicians and the wider aftersales team, the Service Advisor will manage vehicles throughout the service and repair process, keeping customers informed and ensuring work is completed efficiently and to a high standard.
Your responsibilities will include:
Welcoming customers and providing a professional and friendly service
Booking vehicles in for servicing, maintenance and repairs
Managing customer appointments and workshop bookings
Keeping customers updated throughout the service and repair process
Preparing accurate estimates and explaining repair recommendations to customers
Discussing additional work and recommending relevant products and services
Maximising opportunities for additional sales where appropriate
Handling customer queries and resolving issues professionally
Managing customer expectations regarding costs and completion times
Preparing job cards and ensuring accurate vehicle information is recorded
Ensuring all paperwork and computer records are completed accurately
Maintaining excellent levels of customer satisfaction
Working closely with the Workshop Controller and Service Manager
Following manufacturer and company procedures
Supporting the wider Aftersales team when required

ABOUT YOU
We're looking for an experienced Service Advisor with a strong automotive background and excellent customer service skills.
The successful Service Advisor will ideally have:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within an automotive dealership
Minimum 2 years' dealership experience
Experience within an aftersales, workshop or service environment
Strong knowledge of vehicle servicing and repairs
Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask
Ability to manage multiple customer requirements in a busy workshop environment
Confident using computerised dealership systems
Good commercial awareness and the ability to identify additional sales opportunities
Ability to work effectively as part of a busy team
Full UK driving licence desirable
Right to work in the UK

APPLY TODAY
If you're an experienced Service Advisor, Automotive Service Advisor, Aftersales Advisor, Service Receptionist or Dealership Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity in Crewe, offering a £34,500 OTE, regular working hours, manufacturer training and career development, we'd love to hear from you.

For more information or to apply for this Service Advisor vacancy, please contact Kieran at Auto Skills UK & Reference 54973

title: Part-Time Payroll Assistant

description:
Adele Carr Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly respected accountancy practice for an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join their growing payroll team.

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a friendly, supportive business that continues to expand through organic growth and acquisition. Working alongside an experienced team, you'll support the day-to-day processing of multiple client payrolls, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with current payroll legislation.

The business is looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in delivering an exceptional service to clients.

- Processing new starters, leavers, statutory payments, sickness, time sheets and payroll amendments.
- Carrying out National Minimum Wage checks.
- Assisting with the onboarding of new payroll clients.
- Responding to payroll queries via telephone, email and in person.
- Completing monthly pension uploads and reconciling pension contributions.
- Ensuring compliance with Pension Regulator requirements.
- Maintaining GDPR compliance and payroll accuracy.
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with the smooth running of the payroll function.

This role is offered on a part-time basis (15-22.5 hours per week).

The successful candidate must be available to work on Tuesdays, with flexibility around how the remaining hours are worked. The client is happy to consider shorter working days (for example, 6-hour days) or alternative working patterns to suit both the successful candidate and the needs of the business.

As the payroll department continues to grow, there is potential for additional hours in the future.

Benefits

- Employee assistance programme (which includes; Life support, Legal information, Bereavement support, Medical Information, CBT & Managerial Support).
- Life Assurance cover
- Option of salary sacrifice pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity/paternity/shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long service enhancements to employer pension contribution and holiday entitlement
- On site parking
- Team social events

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking for genuine flexibility while continuing to build a career in payroll. Whether you're currently working within an accountancy practice or an in-house payroll team, this role offers the chance to join a growing business where your contribution will be valued and where there is real scope for your hours and responsibilities to develop over time.

If you're looking for a flexible part-time payroll opportunity with an employer that genuinely values its people, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Project Document Controller

We are looking for an experienced Project Document Controller to join our Asset Information Team, supporting the delivery of engineering and refurbishment projects across a complex client environment. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong document control, asset information, or project support experience who enjoys working closely with project teams and stakeholders to ensure critical asset data is accurate, compliant and ready for operational use.

As Project Document Controller, you will play a key role in managing project information throughout the lifecycle of engineering and facilities projects, ensuring that drawings, manuals, maintenance documentation and asset records are accurately updated and transitioned into operational systems.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing the quality, control and transition of project documentation and asset information.
- Working closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Maintenance Teams and Contractors.
- Creating Asset Information Delivery Plans (AIDPs) at project initiation.
- Tracking and reporting progress against project information deliverables.
- Coordinating Requests for Information (RFIs) from contractors and stakeholders.
- Updating engineering drawings, operating procedures and maintenance documentation following project changes.
- Ensuring documentation is correctly loaded into electronic document management systems.
- Supporting the delivery of asset information across multiple databases and systems.
- Attending project progress meetings and providing input on information management activities.
- Monitoring information handover milestones and escalating any risks to delivery.
- Supporting audits and compliance activities through accurate record management.
- Driving continuous improvement and best practice within information management processes.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a Document Controller, Asset Information, Engineering Administration or Project Support role
- Strong working knowledge of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS)
- Experience managing controlled documentation, revision control and document lifecycles
- Excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills
- Strong database management experience
- Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders at all levels

Desirable
- Experience supporting engineering, facilities management, construction or capital projects
- Knowledge of BIM, COBie data and asset information management processes
- Understanding of project delivery and change management processes

Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive information management team
- Opportunity to develop your expertise in asset information and document control
- Contribute to the successful delivery of facilities and infrastructure projects within a world-class environment
